A '''[[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] senator''' from [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] was one of the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] present during [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
